sql: with c as (select series, count(distinct market_ticker) as cand_mkts, count(distinct market_ticker) filter (where mid between 5 and 10) as cand_in_band, count(distinct market_ticker) filter (where mid between 5 and 10 and yes_ask<=7) as cand_cell, max(captured_at)::date as last_tick from mmsell_candidate_ticks where captured_at >= now() - interval '30 days' and series in ('KXTRUMPMENTION','KXAPRPOTUS','KXSECPRESSMENTION','KXBERNIEMENTION','KXMAMDANIMENTION','KXWORLDNEWSMENTION','KXRAINWKND','KXFEDMENTION','KXWCMENTION','KXTRUMPSAY','KXRAIN','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXINX') group by 1) select o.series, o.markets_seen as breadth, o.last_seen_at::date as last_seen, coalesce(c.cand_mkts,0) as cand_mkts_30d, coalesce(c.cand_in_band,0) as in_band_30d, coalesce(c.cand_cell,0) as in_cell_30d, c.last_tick from series_observations o left join c using (series) where o.series in ('KXTRUMPMENTION','KXAPRPOTUS','KXSECPRESSMENTION','KXBERNIEMENTION','KXMAMDANIMENTION','KXWORLDNEWSMENTION','KXRAINWKND','KXFEDMENTION','KXWCMENTION','KXTRUMPSAY','KXRAIN','KXINXU','KXNASDAQ100U','KXINX') order by o.series
